item.title: Patch now: Apache SkyWalking: The SkyWalking OAP /debugging/config/dump endpoint may leak sensitive configuration information of MySQL/PostgreSQL.
item.description:
Apache SkyWalking: exploited (news only) · fix: 10.4.0

First step: Update Apache SkyWalking to 10.4.0 or later.

The SkyWalking OAP /debugging/config/dump endpoint may leak sensitive configuration information of MySQL/PostgreSQL.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-30778
